description: This file is a PHP script for rendering the detailed view of a Contact in a CRM system, including retrieving contact info, permissions, related lists, and rendering a Smarty template.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Custom Smarty class used for rendering templates in the CRM system.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of CRMEntity for the current module.

methods.name: useInternalMailer
methods.description: Checks if internal mailer is enabled.

methods.description: Checks visibility permission for a specific field.

methods.name: getBlocks
methods.description: Retrieves display blocks for the detail view.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceField
methods.description: Gets the sequence number field for the module.

methods.name: isPermitted
methods.description: Checks user permissions for various actions.

methods.name: getEmailParentsList

methods.name: fromName

methods.name: getEmailFields

methods.name: getParentTab
